verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an official MCP Server explicitly enabling AI agents to interact with its payment platform using natural language, covering card issuance and spend controls (marqeta-docs-11, 23, 12, 13), corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page exists. However, evidence is limited to vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on verification of NLP command execution quality or breadth beyond a few endpoints. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of natural-language command execution, evidence of full API coverage via NLP rather than a 'designated set' of endpoints, and hands-on user reports.
